title: Chromatic Fixed-Point Implications for Finite p-Groups
exact_target: Let $H<G$ be subgroups of a finite $p$-group and let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers. For which pairs $(m,n)$ does $$K(m)_*(\Phi^H X)=0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad K(n)_*(\Phi^G X)=0$$ hold for every finite $G$-spectrum $X$?
